name: Five Degrees
summary:
Five Degrees is a free daily browser puzzle game in which the player connects two well-known movies through the actors they share. Starting from the first film, the player picks an actor, then picks a different film that actor appeared in, repeating the process until reaching the second movie. Each actor-to-movie or movie-to-actor jump counts as one hop, and the day's connection must be completed within 10 hops. Actors and movies already used in the current run are marked off, preventing the player from looping through the same entries.

The puzzle resets daily with a new movie pair, numbered sequentially, and results can be shared in a text format similar to Wordle, showing the number of hops used without revealing the solution path.
